findings.title: [P2] Preserve empty trimmed names instead of applying the fallback
findings.body: When `profile.name` is empty or whitespace-only, `trim()` returns `""`. The new `||` treats that valid result as absent and returns `"Anonymous"`, whereas the previous `??` preserved it. This changes the exported function’s existing behavior despite the stated goal of preserving contracts.

findings.title: [P2] Preserve empty trimmed names instead of applying the fallback
findings.body:
For `{ name: "" }` or whitespace-only names, the previous implementation returned `""` after trimming; `name || "Anonymous"` now returns `"Anonymous"`, breaking the existing API behavior for valid string inputs.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
